references.text: Moses held his hands up with the staff, and this influenced the outcome of the battle against Amalek. A similar symbolic action involving a weapon or tool as a sign of God's intervention in the fight.
Moses was commanded to stretch out his staff over the sea. The same pattern where God commands the stretching out of an instrument as a sign of His power and action.
God gives Joshua a promise of victory over Jericho with specific instructions. The same pattern of God's promise to deliver the city into Joshua's hand.
Joshua held his spear extended until all the people in Ai were destroyed. The continuation of the same account regarding the symbolic meaning of the spear.
God promises to give Ai and its king into Joshua's hand. The same promise repeated in verse 18 with a command to stretch out the spear.
Israel's victory over Benjamin at Gibeah. A similar military strategy involving an ambush that was used against Ai.
